about.bio: Final-year CSE student at KL University, specializing in Cyber Security and Blockchain. I build things that solve practical problems — AI voice assistants, security scanners, cloud auditors. I prefer building, testing, and understanding how things work over simply talking about technology.
about.extra: Hyderabad, India · KL University · AWS Cloud Practitioner · Azure Fundamentals

work.title: Security & AI Project Builder
work.desc: Developing hands-on projects across application security, vulnerability assessment, AI-powered development, and cloud security. Working with Python, JavaScript, React, FastAPI, AWS, Docker, Nmap, and OWASP ZAP.

work.title: Leadership & Coordination
work.desc: Organizing technical and innovation-focused events, coordinating with teams on project delivery and student engagement.

projects.name: ChronoPA
projects.desc: Self-hosted personal productivity assistant with calendar management, task tracking, AI-powered daily briefings, and natural-language time interpretation.
projects.long: A self-hosted personal productivity assistant that brings calendar management, task tracking, intelligent reminders, and AI-powered daily planning into one platform. Supports a React web application and native Android application, with a modular backend and multiple AI provider integrations.

projects.name: AWAVS
projects.desc: Modular web application security scanner combining crawling, passive checks, and active testing to analyze application security and generate structured findings.
projects.long: A modular web application security scanner designed to identify common vulnerabilities in authorized testing environments. It combines web crawling, passive security checks, and controlled active testing techniques to analyze application security and generate structured findings with severity-ranked reports and remediation guidance.

projects.name: J.A.R.V.I.S
projects.desc: Desktop voice assistant combining offline speech recognition, text-to-speech, and LLM integration for conversational interactions and desktop automation.
projects.long: A Python-based desktop voice assistant that combines offline speech recognition using Vosk, natural voice responses via Microsoft Edge TTS, and LLM-powered conversational interactions through OpenRouter. Includes wake-word activation, persistent memory, modular action handlers for desktop automation and web search.

projects.name: SentinelScan
projects.desc: Network vulnerability assessment tool correlating Nmap service detection with the National Vulnerability Database to identify potential CVEs.
projects.long: A Python-based vulnerability assessment tool that correlates network service detection results using Nmap with the National Vulnerability Database (NVD). It identifies potential CVEs associated with detected services and presents security findings with CVSS-based severity information to support vulnerability assessment.

projects.name: CloudGuard
projects.desc: Read-only AWS security auditing tool examining IAM policies and S3 bucket configurations for common security risks without modifying infrastructure.
projects.long: A read-only AWS security auditing tool that examines cloud configurations for common security risks. It focuses on identifying overly permissive IAM policies and publicly accessible S3 resources, highlighting configuration weaknesses with structured security findings and JSON output.
